array.string: set -euo pipefail; source "$HOME/.imap-email-backup/imap-backup.env"; IMAP_BACKUP_PASSWORD="$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w -a "$IMAP_EMAIL" -s "${IMAP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE:-imap-backup}")"; IMAP_BACKUP_PASSWORD="$IMAP_BACKUP_PASSWORD" /opt/homebrew/bin/imap-backup single backup --email "$IMAP_EMAIL" --server "$IMAP_SERVER" --password-environment-variable IMAP_BACKUP_PASSWORD --path "$IMAP_BACKUP_DIR" --refresh
